title: ‘BTS Lyrics Inside’: The K-Pop Supergroup Breaks Down Its Own Songs in a New Book
summary: Calling all ARMY! The Bangtan Boys' new book is available for preorder right now.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

In early June, Running Press announced a new music book in partnership with the K-pop supergroup BTS.

On sale for $26.10 (regularly $28) on Amazon, BTS Lyrics Inside is a new book that explores 10 songs from the superstars’ albums Proof and the Most Beautiful Moments in Life series. Members RM, Jin, SUGA, j-hope, Jimin, V and Jung Kook breakdown the deeper meaning and messages of songs including “Boy With Luv” (featuring Halsey), “ON,” “Life Goes On” and “IDOL.”

The lyrics book is ready for preorder right now, with release set for Tuesday, Sept. 15. Additionally, the publishing company has a BTS cookbook titled BTS Recipe Book , which is also available for preorder with release on the same date.

And if you’re an Amazon Prime member, you can preorder now and BTS Lyrics Inside — which is a No. 1 release from the retail giant — will be delivered to your home in less than two days, thanks to Prime Delivery, when it’s released.

BTS Lyrics Inside is also available as a Kindle ebook. It’s less expensive than the physical hardcover book, as it’s priced at $14.99. The ebook version comes out on Tuesday, Sept. 15. If you preorder now, it will be delivered digitally to your Kindle or Kindle mobile app upon release.

The book BTS Lyrics Inside by BTS is on sale for $26.10 (regularly $28) on Amazon. It’s available for preorder and comes out on Sept. 15.

Meanwhile, the music book is available for preorder at BookShop.org for $26.10 (regularly $28) , while BTS Lyrics Inside can be preordered at Barnes & Noble priced at $28 .
